auth_methods.quote: can authenticate themselves using basic authentication with an Atlassian account email address and API token .
auth_methods.note: Jira Cloud: email+API token (basic) and OAuth 2.0 3LO. JWT (Connect apps) is for app frameworks, not own-credential calls. Data Center PATs excluded (Cloud scope).

credential_access.quote: can authenticate themselves using basic authentication with an Atlassian account email address and API token .
credential_access.note: API token/3LO app creation free in developer console; Jira Cloud has a free plan. Quote doesn't state plan pricing; judged from Atlassian free plan knowledge.

production_gate.quote: Users trying to install an unapproved OAuth 2.0 integration are warned that the app has not yet been reviewed by Atlassian.
production_gate.note: Sharing a 3LO app works without review but shows a warning; approval via Marketplace listing process. Also Atlassian says apps collecting API tokens violate its security requirements. Could be read as marketplace_listing.

api_type.note: rest vs rest+graphql. Jira Cloud REST v3 is the primary documented API. Atlassian also documents a platform GraphQL gateway that exposes Jira projects, listed as beta/limited. Best guess: [rest, graphql].

mcp_official.quote: Atlassian MCP server connects your AI agent to your Atlassian apps and work
mcp_official.note: Atlassian-hosted remote MCP server covers Jira.

main_blocker_type.quote: Apps that collect API tokens or instruct customers to create individual 3LO apps don't comply with our Security requirements for cloud apps and Acceptable use policy .
main_blocker_type.note: Self-serve access exists; difficulty is multi-tenant distribution via a single 3LO app (and Cloud vs DC differences). Alternative reading: access/gate via Marketplace review.
